text: we bought this for our son for his 4th birthday. it seemed great at first, flashy and fun to look at, goes really fast...but 3 weeks after buying it the charger came apart completely. thankfully i filled out the warranty card and sent it in as soon as we bought it so they replaced it without any questions. all total i've had to call for 3 replacement chargers. the rubber tread around the tires comes flying off almost instantly and eventually the tires cracked in half (like a bagel)...first it was two tires so i had to call and wait about a week to receive the replacements and as soon as i got them the other two tires cracked and broke in the same way so down for another week while we waited for those replacement tires. i asked the woman on the phone if there was any limit to how many times i can call for broken parts because i was calling so much...all total i had to call for new tires 4 times, all for the same reason. i asked once what happens when something breaks that isn't a part i can call up and ask for and was told that they have a service location for their products...an hour away!! so we'd have to find the time to get the monstrous toy there, drop it off wait to hear back about it being done then have the time (and space) to go pick it up again. a weld broke underneath the front end, my husband welds and figured rather than bother with all that he would fix it himself, long story short the thing caught fire!! he said the tiniest spark hit the plastic and it burst into flames faster than anything he's ever seen. it literally meltled like an ice cream cone. we will never ever ever be buying a dynacraft product again. we have a power wheels from my older son and it's about 5 and a half years old...still running on it's original battery!! never needed a single thing replaced. save your money

text: i bought this as a (requested) gift for a disadvantaged child. i know money should not an issue when giving gifts, but gosh......for that amount of money, i expected a "wow!" factor when this item arrived, because that was what i was wanting for the child...to be "wowed!" when she opens the gift on christmas day. however, what you see in the advertisement photographs and what you actually get after your order are totally different. as it is, this little purse was sealed in an ordinary plastic bag, not as a toy in a box, with all the accessories nicely displayed around the handbag. i had to tear open the plastic bag so i could look inside the purse and be sure all the items were in it. peaking inside. the items which were so glamorously displayed in the advertisement photos, were simply shoved inside and seemed to be about the value of stuff i would pick up at the dollar store. after being sure all the accessories were indeed inside the purse, i had to carefully reseal the plastic bag in which the purse had been sent and that ended up being a mess. thankfully, i had some heart stickers i could stick on the tape; hopefully, it will seem as if that is the way the factory sent the item. all said and done, the little child asked for this gift, and i sincerely hope she isn't disappointed. i sure am. (review by mrs. bassman)

text:
i wanted to love this purse. it is absolutely the cutest thing. white patent leather look. purple (thank you - something other than pink!). not to mention seeing my 2.5 year old daughter play mommy while tending to her baby in her stroller with her purse on her shoulder, absolutely melts my heart. regrettably, that only lasted 1 week. 7 days. 168 hours. 10,080 minutes. then, one of the handle straps completely came off. and yes, for the price her aunt paid for it as a present, i am sad. but what frustrated me is i reached out to litti pritti 5 days ago about a replacement, and have heard nothing. in this day and age. super sad. now that i read the other reviews, i'm bummed her aunt didn't read them prior. turns out the straps breaking, is a regular thing, so regular they should really pull the product from the market. so now i'm attempting to glue it back on with tacky glue and seeing if it will hold as my 2.5 year old really misses her purse.however if that holds, the other handle isn't far behind in falling off. i absolutely love the accessories in it. the wallet seems well made, and has a snap on it for closure. the money looks so real that sometimes i catch myself picking it up and putting it on the counter as if it's real money. the "license" is so cool; it has the option to insert a photo of your little one. if all else fails, i will buy a better made purse for $5. don't waste your money. litti pritti makes some pretty cool things for littles, but this is not it.
update: 1.21.20
i'm happy to report i finally did hear back from contacting litti pritti on january 9th and they advised there were issues with the 1st shipment of this style purse. they will be launching a new make in mid-february of 2020 which they offered to ship to my daughter as a replacement when available. they also offered to send her a complimentary make-up kit right away for our hassle (or fully refund our money, however i opted for the replacement and bonus make up kit because she absolutely loves it) however this was 12 day's ago and she still hasn't seen it. will update again when both come.
